account.description: One account: its account_hash (from list_accounts), the last 3 or more digits of its number (135 or ...135), its store ref (A1) or its nickname; every account when left out.

symbol.description: One symbol, in any case: the positions whose symbol or underlying is it, such as a stock and its options.

detail.description: compact (the default) or full, which adds fields.

limit.description: The most positions a page holds, 1 to 200; 100 when left out.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same other arguments.
